pokedexEntries.sc: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

pokedexEntries.vi: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

pokedexEntries.za: Shroodle protects itself from foes using both its poisonous saliva and its front teeth, which are disproportionately big and long for its small body.
